proof_body:
by
  intro n hn z
  haveI : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hz : z ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [zero_pow hn.ne'] at h
      exact zero_ne_one h
    have hm : Units.mk0 z hz ∈ rootsOfUnity n ℂ := by
      rw [mem_rootsOfUnity']
      simpa using h
    obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := (Complex.mem_rootsOfUnity n _).1 hm
    exact ⟨k, hk, by simpa using he.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, _, rfl⟩
    rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
    have hn' : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne'
    have he : (n : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (k / n)) = (k : ℤ) * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) := by
      push_cast
      field_simp
    rw [he, Complex.exp_eq_one_iff]
    exact ⟨k, rfl⟩
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ z : ℂ, z ^ n = 1 ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, k < n ∧ z = Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (k / n))
